verdict.rationale: Stripe's webhook docs say you can register an HTTPS webhook endpoint, and Stripe then pushes real-time event data to it so your integration can trigger reactions automatically. This covers the core of subscribing to events. However, the evidence is platform-level Stripe documentation and is not specific to Terminal. Missing for 10: Terminal-specific event types (e.g., reader action events), details on event filtering, signature verification and retries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
